title: Quick Crisp Japanese Tofu Gyoza
description: A delicious and earthy lacto-vegetarian Japanese dish featuring crispy tofu and brandy, perfect for a dinner party

ingredients.name: firm tofu
ingredients.notes: drained and cut into small pieces

instructions: In a large bowl, combine the flour and cornstarch
Add the tofu pieces to the bowl and toss to coat evenly
Heat the vegetable oil in a deep frying pan to 350 degrees
Add the coated tofu to the hot oil and fry until golden brown
Remove the tofu from the oil and place on a paper towel-lined plate
In a small bowl, whisk together the brandy, soy sauce, and sesame oil
Pour the brandy mixture over the fried tofu and toss to coat
Sprinkle the chopped green onions over the top of the tofu
Serve the gyoza hot and enjoy
